title: Month-over-Month Revenue Growth
hints: Aggregate first: revenue per date_trunc('month', order_date) for completed orders only.
LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) gives the previous row, which is NOT necessarily the previous calendar month when a month has no orders. Also LAG the month itself and compare.
Guard the division: when the previous month's revenue is 0 (or missing) the growth is NULL.
